title: Complexity of Projected Gradient Methods for Strongly Convex Optimization with Hölder Continuous Gradient Terms
summary: This paper studies the complexity of projected gradient descent methods for a class of strongly convex constrained optimization problems where the objective function is expressed as a summation of $m$ component functions, each possessing a gradient that is Hölder continuous with an exponent $α_i \in (0, 1]$. Under this formulation, the gradient of the objective function may fail to be globally Hölder continuous, thereby rendering existing complexity results inapplicable to this class of problems.
